from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors

# Heavy atom graph transcribed from mol_0034.png
# 0 iPr methine; 1 core; 2,3 iPr methyls
# 12 carbonyl carbon, 13 carbonyl O, 14 lactone O, 27 aminyl N
bonds = [
(0,1),(0,2),(0,3),
(1,4),(1,7),
(4,5),(5,6),
(6,9),(6,25),(6,28),
(7,8),(7,9),
(9,10),(9,15),
(10,11),(11,12),
(12,14),(14,15),
(15,16),(15,19),
(16,17),(17,18),
(19,20),(19,21),(19,23),
(21,22),
(23,24),(24,25),(25,26),
(26,27),
]
# elements by index
els = {0:'C',1:'C',2:'C',3:'C',4:'C',5:'C',6:'C',7:'C',8:'C',9:'C',10:'C',11:'C',12:'C',13:'O',14:'O',15:'C',16:'C',17:'C',18:'C',19:'C',20:'C',21:'C',22:'C',23:'C',24:'C',25:'C',26:'C',27:'N',28:'C'}
m=Chem.RWMol()
for i in range(29):
    a=Chem.Atom(els[i])
    if i==27:
        a.SetNumRadicalElectrons(1)
        # one explicit H will be added based on [NH] radical valence
    m.AddAtom(a)
for i,j in bonds:
    m.AddBond(i,j,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if (i,j)==(12,13) else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
# oops carbonyl bond missing from list, add explicitly if not present
if m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(12,13) is None:
    m.AddBond(12,13,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
# sanitize radical molecule; update props
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
mol=m.GetMol()
print('heavy',mol.GetNumAtoms(),'formula noHs',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mol))
for a in mol.GetAtoms():
    if a.GetSymbol()=='N': print('N before',a.GetTotalValence(),a.GetTotalNumHs(),a.GetNumRadicalElectrons())
molh=Chem.AddHs(mol)
print('all',molh.GetNumAtoms(),'formula',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(molh))
print('radicals',sum(a.GetNumRadicalElectrons() for a in molh.GetAtoms()))
for a in molh.GetAtoms():
    if a.GetSymbol()=='N': print('N after',a.GetTotalValence(),a.GetTotalNumHs(),a.GetNumRadicalElectrons(), 'degree',a.GetDegree())
print('bonds',mol.GetNumBonds(),'ring count',mol.GetRingInfo().NumRings())
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(mol))
PY

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
import os, math

# Heavy atom graph transcribed from mol_0034.png
bonds = [
    (0,1),(0,2),(0,3),          # isopropyl substituent
    (1,4),(1,7),(4,5),(5,6),    # left ring / linker
    (6,9),(6,25),(6,28),        # central junction + Me substituent
    (7,8),(7,9),                # methyl and ring closure
    (9,10),(9,15),
    (10,11),(11,12),            # lactone carbonyl chain
    (12,14),(14,15),            # ester O and closure
    (15,16),(15,19),
    (16,17),(17,18),            # propyl substituent
    (19,20),(19,21),(19,23),    # methyl, ethyl, and ring continuation
    (21,22),
    (23,24),(24,25),
    (25,26),(26,27),            # aminomethyl radical side chain
]
els = ['C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','O','O','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','N','C']

m = Chem.RWMol()
for i,el in enumerate(els):
    a = Chem.Atom(el)
    if i == 27:  # neutral aminyl radical shown as N with a single dot
        a.SetNumRadicalElectrons(1)
    m.AddAtom(a)
for i,j in bonds:
    m.AddBond(i,j,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
m.AddBond(12,13,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
base = m.GetMol()
mol = Chem.AddHs(base)
assert rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mol) == 'C26H46NO2'
assert sum(a.GetNumRadicalElectrons() for a in mol.GetAtoms()) == 1
assert mol.GetNumAtoms() == 75

# Generate a diverse pool of conformers; keep UFF-lowest.
params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
params.randomSeed = 0xD34DB33F
params.enableSequentialRandomSeeds = True
params.numThreads = 4
params.useRandomCoords = True
params.maxIterations = 1000
params.pruneRmsThresh = 0.3
params.timeout = 0
ids = AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mol, numConfs=300, params=params)
if not ids:
    raise RuntimeError('RDKit conformer embedding failed')
print(f'Embedded {len(ids)} conformers')
results=[]
for cid in ids:
    status = AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(mol, confId=int(cid), maxIters=2000)
    ff = AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(mol, confId=int(cid))
    e = ff.CalcEnergy()
    results.append((e,int(cid),status))
results.sort()
print('best ten energies:', [round(x[0],3) for x in results[:10]])
best_e,best_cid,status = results[0]
conf = mol.GetConformer(best_cid)
# Write XYZ with all explicit H
def write_xyz(m, conf, path, comment):
    n=m.GetNumAtoms()
    with open(path,'w') as f:
        f.write(f'{n}\n{comment}\n')
        pos=conf.GetPositions()
        for a,p in zip(m.GetAtoms(),pos):
            f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
write_xyz(mol,conf,'rdkit_best.xyz',f'C26H46NO2 aminyl radical; ETKDG/UFF conformer {best_cid}, UFF E={best_e:.6f}')
# Also save mol block for topology checking
Chem.MolToMolFile(mol,'topology.mol',confId=best_cid)
print('best',best_e,best_cid,'status',status)
PY

bonds = [(0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(1,4),(1,7),(4,5),(5,6),(6,9),(6,25),(6,28),(7,8),(7,9),(9,10),(9,15),(10,11),(11,12),(12,14),(14,15),(15,16),(15,19),(16,17),(17,18),(19,20),(19,21),(19,23),(21,22),(23,24),(24,25),(25,26),(26,27),(12,13)]
lines=open('xtbopt.xyz').read().splitlines()[2:]
ats=[l.split()[0] for l in lines]; xyz=[tuple(map(float,l.split()[1:4])) for l in lines]
def d(i,j): return math.dist(xyz[i],xyz[j])
print('heavy bond lengths:')
for b in bonds:
 print(b,ats[b[0]]+ats[b[1]],round(d(*b),3))
# count hydrogens attached to each heavy by distance threshold
for i in range(29):
 hs=[]
 for j in range(29,len(ats)):
  if d(i,j)<1.25: hs.append(j)
 print(i,ats[i],'Hs',len(hs),'heavy',[(j,round(d(i,j),2)) for j in range(29) if j!=i and d(i,j)<1.8])
PY
